section: Summary of Benefits for the Elevate Option of the Government Employees Health Association, Inc. 2026

rows.Elevate Benefits: Medical services provided by physicians: Diagnostic and treatment services provided in the office
rows.You pay: In-network: Nothing for preventive care; $10 copay primary care provider; $30 copay specialist

rows.Elevate Benefits: Services provided by a hospital: Inpatient
Services provided by a hospital: Outpatient
Mental health and substance use disorder treatment:

rows.You pay: Network pharmacy: • Generic: Member pays lesser of $10 or pharmacy's usual and customary cost for 30-day supply • Preferred Brand: Member pays 50% of Plan allowance up to a maximum of $500 for 30-day supply • Non-Preferred Brand: Member pays 100% of all charges
Accidental Dental coverage only. Services are paid at regular medical Plan benefits.

rows.Elevate Benefits: Protection against catastrophic costs (your catastrophic protection out-of-pocket maximum):
rows.You pay: Nothing after $10,600 Self Only ($21,200 Self Plus One or Self and Family) per year for in-network providers. Nothing after $17,000 Self Only ($34,000 Self Plus One or Self and Family) per year for out-of-network providers.
